Open Design
Brand brief / 2026

Open / Local-first / Agent-native

Open Design.

Turn a clear idea into a real artifact — locally, collaboratively and with the right agent in the loop.

Open Design brings a living template system, production-ready formats and agent-native workflows into one place. Teams move from brief to interface, deck, image, video or export without losing the context that made the work clear.

Built for

Product teams, design partners and individual creators who need a usable artifact, not another closed canvas.

Artifact range

Interface, deck, image, video or export — without losing the context.
